description: This file is a shell script containing tests for 'git fetch' and 'git pull' commands with the '--set-upstream' option. It sets up a testing environment, defines helper functions, and runs various test cases to verify the behavior of upstream tracking configuration in git.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Verifies that the git configuration for a given branch matches expected remote and merge references.

methods.name: check_config_missing
methods.description: Checks that the git configuration for a given branch related to remote and merge is absent (returns an error code 1).

methods.name: clear_config
methods.description: Removes remote and merge configuration entries for specified branches.

methods.name: ensure_fresh_upstream
methods.description: Creates a new bare git repository named 'parent' to serve as upstream.
